$description: Promoted from tokens/primitive/effect.json. These were always INTENT names — `modal`, `tooltip`, `backdrop`, `hover-overlay` describe a job in the UI, not raw material — so tier 1 was the wrong home and every component reading them was breaking the read-tier-2 rule through no fault of its own. Names are unchanged; only the tier moved.

hover-overlay.$description: Neutral wash for hover on a surface that has no colour of its own.

hover-overlay-strong.$description: As above, where the surface needs more separation. Aliases the black-alpha ramp — the value was already exactly this step.

active-overlay.$description: Pressed/selected wash — the highlighted option in a dropdown, a selected chip, a drag-over drop zone. DERIVED from the brand rather than fixed, so a spoke re-pointing --color-primary moves it too. It was rgba(0, 88, 98, 0.08), a teal left over from an older brand, which is why selected rows used to read cool in a green UI.

hover-overlay-heavy.$description: The heaviest wash — a control that sits ON a tinted surface and needs to read as pressable against it (the pill's remove button).

backdrop.$description: Scrim behind dialogs, side dialogs and the confirm dialog.

scrim-light.$description: Light counterpart to `backdrop` — veils content in place rather than behind a dialog, so what is underneath stays readable (the loading overlay).

min.$description: WCAG 2.5.5 floor. A role, not a ramp step — never re-point it smaller.

1.$description: Resting lift — subtle depth for always-visible surfaces.

6.$description: Full-screen overlays that float above everything — the command palette, entity search. Deliberately heavier than the modal step.
